_layer: IDENTITY (EXAMPLE). The canonical anchor-to-URL table the CV is rebuilt from on every build.
_why_this_exists: Because copying the previous application's DOCX carries forward DRIFTED links. Copying preserves formatting, not link correctness: a press link silently becomes a homepage, a keynote becomes a marketing page, and half the set quietly goes missing. Re-derive from this file on every build instead of trusting the base document.
_rules: Partial-text anchor only: link the product, press, or talk word - never the whole title or company line.
Never link a generic company homepage. It reads as filler and tells a reader nothing.
Link an anchor only if that text survives in the final CV; if a bullet was cut, its link drops too.
Target range lives in config/documents.json under links.min / links.max.
_note_on_the_first_three: These match the placeholder links already embedded in engine/templates/cv/cv_template_01.docx, so a fresh install audits clean before you have changed anything. Replace them with your own and the template's placeholders will then correctly fail the audit - which is the signal to update the template too.
_never_link: Repos you would not want a hiring manager to actually read
_deny_rationale: Put URLs here that your base document keeps reintroducing in place of the canonical one. The auditor hard-fails on these, which is the only reliable way to stop a link from silently regressing build after build.
